newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cesp to set $200 mln bond via JP Morgan.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cesp to set $200 mln bond via JP Morgan.

text.p: Sao Paulo state power company Cesp plans by March to launch a 10-year $200 million Eurobond, with puts and calls after five years, via lead manager JP Morgan, Cesp international affairs chief Octavio de Barros said.
"We plan to do this by the end of March but we cannot have a roadshow until we close our 1996 books, which we're trying to do now," Barros told Reuters.

Barros said the $200 million bond was the first tranche of Cesp's $500 million Eurobond program for 1997. While JP Morgan is arranging the $500 million program and lead managing the first tranche, the bank may not necessarily lead manage subsequent tranches, Barros said.
He added that Cesp may decide to do another tranche before the end of June and another in September. Those bonds could be denominated in marks, Italian lire or yen, he said.
